City of Chicago
                                                                    O2021-3725
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 9/14/2021
Sponsor(s):                    Ramirez-Rosa (35)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 5-J at 3335 W Fullerton
                              Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO;

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe C1-2,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-J in
the area bound by;

      West Fullerton Avenue; a line 71.15 feet east of and parallel to North Kimball Avenue;
      the alley immediately south of and parallel to West Fullerton Avenue; and. North Kimball
      Avenue

to those of a B3-1, Community Shopping District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                         Carlos Ramirez-Rosa
                                                         Alderman, 35*'' Ward




Common Address:
3335 West Fullerton Avenue
